inputs.checklistItemText: Setbacks adjacent to residential uses or zoning not shown on plans
inputs.question: Are setback lines adjacent to residential uses or residential zoning shown on this site plan? Look specifically for compatibility setback lines or building setback lines near properties zoned SF-3 or other residential zones.
inputs.regionHint: western property boundary adjacent to SF-3 zoned properties

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether setback lines (a drawing element/annotation) are shown on the site plan adjacent to residential uses or zones. This is a visual inspection of whether specific lines and their spatial relationships to zoned areas are depicted on the drawing, not a measurement of setback distance or a generic presence/document check.
